title: Know and Achieve
simplified_paragraphs: 有一次，美国通用电气首席执行官杰克·韦尔奇应邀来中国给企业管理人员讲课。然而，听完课，很多人却感到很失望。他们问杰克·韦尔奇："您讲的那些内容，我们也差不多知道，可是为什么我们之间的差距会那么大呢？”杰克·韦尔奇回答："那是因为你们只是知道，而我却做到了，这就是我们的差别。”
从"知道”到"做到”，需要付诸行动，克服种种困难。很多人尽管"知道”却无法"做到”，原因大致有两个：一个是缺乏吃苦耐劳的精神，不能坚持到最后；另一个就是停留在"知道”的空谈，光说不做。
不去尝试，不去坚持，即使"知道”，最终成功也只能是一种空谈。
traditional_paragraphs: 有一次，美國通用電氣首席執行官傑克·韋爾奇應邀來中國給企業管理人員講課。然而，聽完課，很多人卻感到很失望。他們問傑克·韋爾奇："您講的那些內容，我們也差不多知道，可是為什麼我們之間的差距會那麼大呢？”傑克·韋爾奇回答："那是因為你們只是知道，而我卻做到了，這就是我們的差別。”
從"知道”到"做到”，需要付諸行動，克服種種困難。很多人儘管"知道”卻無法"做到”，原因大致有兩個：一個是缺乏吃苦耐勞的精神，不能堅持到最後；另一個就是停留在"知道”的空談，光說不做。
不去嘗試，不去堅持，即使"知道”，最終成功也只能是一種空談。

english_paragraphs: Once, Jack Welch, the CEO of General Electric, was invited to China to speak to business managers. But after his talk, many of them felt disappointed. They asked him, “We already know most of what you told us, so why is the gap between us so large?” Welch replied, “Because you only know what to do, while I have actually done it. That’s the difference between us.”

To go from knowing to doing, you have to take action and overcome all kinds of difficulties. There are roughly two reasons why many people know what to do but fail to do it: some lack the willingness to work hard and cannot see things through to the end; others stop at talking about what they know and never act.
If you never try and never keep at it, then even if you know what to do, success will remain nothing more than talk.
english_full:
Once, Jack Welch, the CEO of General Electric, was invited to China to speak to business managers. But after his talk, many of them felt disappointed. They asked him, “We already know most of what you told us, so why is the gap between us so large?” Welch replied, “Because you only know what to do, while I have actually done it. That’s the difference between us.”

To go from knowing to doing, you have to take action and overcome all kinds of difficulties. There are roughly two reasons why many people know what to do but fail to do it: some lack the willingness to work hard and cannot see things through to the end; others stop at talking about what they know and never act.

If you never try and never keep at it, then even if you know what to do, success will remain nothing more than talk.
